subject: Transportation Systems
title: Japan's Chuo Shinkansen
description: A short lesson to help you apply Japan's Chuo Shinkansen.

hook.text: Japan is building a maglev line from Tokyo to Osaka. It will cut the trip to just 67 minutes.

buildup.text: The Chuo Shinkansen will run mostly underground, tunneling through the Japanese Alps at 314 mph.

discovery.text: The project costs over $80 billion—funded entirely by JR Central, a private company, without government money.

twist.text: Environmental disputes and tunnel construction problems have delayed the opening past its 2027 target.

climax.text: If it opens, it will be the first long-distance maglev in the world—and the proof the technology can scale.

punchline.text: Japan is betting $80 billion that maglev can work at scale.

quiz.question: Who is funding Japan's Chuo Shinkansen maglev line?
